fact: Le Sahel reports the World Bank-backed WURI project is developing a National Population Register (RNP) to be interoperable with the civil-status and nationality registers, run by the new ANEI agency.

Niger's director general of territorial administration announced reforms creating the ANEI agency for registration and identification of natural persons, a National Population Register and a National Civil Status Register, with secure interconnection of the systems.
system: ANEI / Registre National de la Population

fact: Officials said the planned National Population Register (RNP) will be interoperable with the civil-registration management system and the biometric ID card, with progressive interconnection of national registers.

Le Sahel says Niger created the ANEI, the agency for registration and identification of persons, to administer the RNP and its associated registers, alongside operationalising a national civil-status register (ordonnance 2026-21).

Niger's deputy secretary general of the Interior ministry announced a forthcoming National Population Register that will be interoperable with civil-status management systems, the biometric national card and travel documents.
